# Template: solow_growth
The Solow growth diagram: capital per worker (k) against output per worker, with the production function f(k), the savings/investment curve s·f(k), the break-even investment line (n+δ)k, the steady state k* computed exactly where they cross, and an optional consumption gap arrow between output and savings at k*. savings and depreciation are numeric, so `animate` can slide the savings rate and honestly move the steady state. Choose this scene for ANY request about the Solow model, economic growth theory, steady-state capital, savings and investment per worker, capital accumulation and depreciation, or why saving more raises the level but not the long-run growth rate.
Parameter schema:
{
 "type": "object",
 "properties": {
  "savings": {
   "type": "number",
   "description": "Savings rate s, 0.05-0.6 (default 0.3)."
  },
  "depreciation": {
   "type": "number",
   "description": "Break-even rate n+δ, 0.05-0.3 (default 0.15)."
  },
  "alpha": {
   "type": "number",
   "description": "Capital share α in f(k)=k^α, 0.2-0.5 (default 0.33)."
  },
  "show_output": {
   "type": "boolean",
   "description": "Draw the production function f(k) above the savings curve (default true)."
  },
  "show_steady": {
   "type": "boolean",
   "description": "Mark the steady state k* with a dashed guide (default true)."
  },
  "show_consumption": {
   "type": "boolean",
   "description": "Vertical consumption arrow between f(k*) and s·f(k*) (default false; needs show_output)."
  },
  "title": {
   "type": "string"
  }
 }
}
Element ids your commands can reference:
- axes: the coordinate axes (a group with captions)
- output: the production function f(k) with its end label (when show_output)
- savings_curve: the s·f(k) curve with its end label
- breakeven: the (n+δ)k line with its end label
- steady: the steady state (dot, dashed guide to the axis, k* caption; a group, when show_steady)
- consumption_arrow: the consumption gap arrow at k* (a group, when show_consumption)
- title: figure title, when set
Examples:
Request: "Draw the Solow growth model with its steady state." → params: {"title":"The Solow model"}
Request: "Show consumption as the gap between output and savings in the Solow diagram." → params: {"show_consumption":true,"title":"Who eats the output?"}

In YAML: `template: solow_growth` and `params:` per the schema above; commands name the element ids above.
